meta.note: Tokens the app needs that the claude.ai design system (tokens.json, copied verbatim) does not define. Same format as tokens.json (groups of {name, value, usage}); values may alias tokens.json. When the design system gains one of these, delete it here: the generator fails on duplicates.

tokens.name: color.league.ladder
tokens.usage: The league ladder's other steps on street-card.bg (.pd-ladder i).

tokens.name: color.avatar.1
tokens.usage: Initials avatar background, first of four (.pd-avatar).

tokens.name: color.avatar.2
tokens.usage: Initials avatar background, second of four.

tokens.name: color.avatar.3
tokens.usage: Initials avatar background, third of four.

tokens.name: color.avatar.4
tokens.usage: Initials avatar background, fourth of four.

color.note: Colours the design system's component CSS uses as primitives directly (league ladder, avatars).

tokens.name: motion.shimmer
tokens.usage: One sweep of the skeleton shimmer (.pd-skel::after in the design system's bundle.css), repeating while content loads.

duration.note: Durations the design system uses in its component CSS but has no token for.

tokens.name: opacity.shimmer
tokens.usage: The skeleton shimmer's peak over color.surface.sunken (.pd-skel::after).

opacity.note: Opacities the design system uses in its component CSS but has no token for.
